{"narrative": "Western Union ( WU ) allowed for my information to be stolen and used online to transfer a vast amount of funds from my CC to a person located in XXXX, the first attempt was successful, the immediate second attempt was rejected by my bank. 

I disputed the transaction using the Chat system WU provides and was told by " XXXX  XXXX. '' that since the funds were already picked up, that there was probably nothing they could do about the incident. 

I was directed by the same person to place a fraud complain online at WU.com, when I did, I continuously received the message that the " MTCN Number '' was a duplicate thus not allowing for me to make the fraud report/complaint online. 

It is not the first time one of WU 's IT suppliers is hacked which causes much suffering on us victims. I have officially lost all of my faith and trust I had in Western Union."}
